name: Northline
description: Dark, minimal palette balanced for OLED and standard LCD monitors. ui/ui.py turns this file into CSS variables (--navy, --text, --muted, --up, --down, --brand, --line, --hover, --input, --sans, --mono); change the look here, not in ui.py. tests/test_template.py checks the colours and the contrast.

navy.name: Navy
navy.use: Page background, cards, panels, chart area (the ONLY background colour)

muted.name: Steel blue
muted.use: Secondary text, labels, chart axes, grid lines, borders; 'needs attention' (with a diamond marker)

up.name: Jade green
up.use: Price up, profit, buy; healthy / ok states

down.name: Rose red
down.use: Price down, loss, sell, alerts; errors / failed states

brand.name: Coral
brand.use: Brand accent ONLY: app name / logo, keyboard focus outline

up_fade.use: Chart volume bars for rising candles (faint jade green)

down_fade.use: Chart volume bars for falling candles (faint rose red)

fonts.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

sizes_note: Spacing scale s1..s6, corner radii (controls / cards / pills), control heights, type scale, layout widths. ui/ui.py uses only these (as CSS variables, e.g. var(--s4)); tests/test_template.py checks it.
rules: Medium saturation: not neon, not washed-out pastel. Must look good on both OLED and standard LCD monitors.
No pure white (#FFFFFF) and no pure black (#000000).
One navy only. Separate cards with thin steel-blue borders (tint 'line').
Green and red are for market meaning (up/down, buy/sell, profit/loss) and for ok / error states. Pair market values with arrows or +/- signs.
Coral is ONLY for brand: the app name / logo and the keyboard focus outline. Never near prices.
Text on green, red and coral buttons is navy.
Focus outline for keyboard users: 2px coral.
Prices and big numbers use the monospace font; all numbers use tabular digits.
'Needs attention' is steel blue with a diamond marker; there is no amber.
Chart fills: a faint green or red fade (about 18% opacity); no other gradients or colours.
